import os
lines = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk("logs"):
    for f in files:
        p = os.path.join(root, f)
        lines.append(f"== {p} ==")
        with open(p) as fh:
            for i, line in enumerate(fh, 1):
                lines.append(f"{i}: {line.rstrip()}")
text = "\n".join(lines)
print(text[:8000] if len(text) > 8000 else text)
print("... TOTAL CHARS:", len(text))

import glob, re, os
started, errored, done = set(), set(), set()
for f in glob.glob('logs/app-*.log'):
    for line in open(f):
        m = re.search(r'(req-\d+)', line)
        if not m: continue
        rid = m.group(1)
        if re.search(r'\bstart\b', line): started.add(rid)
        if re.search(r'\bERROR\b', line): errored.add(rid)
        if re.search(r'\bdone\b', line): done.add(rid)
stuck = sorted(r for r in started if r in errored and r not in done)
# sanity: ids in error lines but never started
weird = sorted(errored - started)
print('started:', len(started), 'errored:', len(errored), 'done:', len(done))
print('stuck:', stuck)
print('errored-but-never-started:', weird)
print('done-but-never-started:', sorted(done - started)[:10])
os.makedirs('out', exist_ok=True)
with open('out/stuck.txt', 'w') as fh:
    fh.write('\n'.join(stuck) + ('\n' if stuck else ''))
print('wrote', len(stuck), 'ids to out/stuck.txt')
